article.title: Inside Gaza’s ‘widows camp,’ where women now support their families alone
article.author: Tareq S. Hajjaj
article.content: Women in Gaza who lost their husbands in the genocide are caught between the need to work and the pain of leaving their children alone, susceptible to Israeli violence. According to the UN, these women now represent 1 in 4 households in Gaza.
